title: Enrichment Configuration Guide for Palo Alto Networks WildFire

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler Deception with Palo Alto Networks WildFire. You can send the Deception evidence files to the Palo Alto Networks WildFire sandbox to enrich incident investigations and response.
Before you configure the enrichment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: An active Palo Alto Networks WildFire account.
The Palo Alto Networks WildFire console URL.
Obtained the Palo Alto Networks WildFire API key. In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console, go to My Account and copy the API key.

blocks.heading: Configuring the Enrichment Integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire

blocks.text: To configure the enrichment integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire:

blocks.item: Locate Palo Alto Networks WildFire in the table, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire window:
Enter the URL of the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console.
The enrichment integration with Palo Alto Networks WildFire is enabled.

blocks.text: To test the integration, run an application file on a network decoy with Windows service enabled. When an alert is generated on the Investigate dashboard, send the evidence file to the Palo Alto Networks WildFire sandbox. After you send the evidence file to the sandbox, you can download the report for analysis.
